paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 41:4 and 50:10.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has Tuvi (טובי). The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Bereshit Rabbah 41:4 and 50:10 has Rabbi Toviah (טוביה), with both bar Yitzchak and bar Rabbi Yitzchak forms. These exact cited occurrences support Rabbi for the subject; Tuvi and the heading's untitled Yitzchak remain as supplied. No father title is transferred from the witness.
